text:
sophia: Heads-up — starting formal bring-up for cobalt-13b-qlo on Dedicated. Wants: quant experiments, evals vs nova-13b baseline, and a short prompt + toolcall formatting checklist. :eyes:
raj: I pushed an initial PTQ 4-bit build to staging. logs: https://run.redwood.ai/runs/12345
raj: Quick note — tool-calling structured JSON responses are failing our validator on a few prompts. example payload we used:
```json
{
  \"tool\": \"lookup_price\",
  \"args\": {
    \"symbol\": \"AAPL\"
  }
}
```
olivia: Can you paste the failing model output? might be a tokenization/escape issue.
raj: output snippet: `{"tool": "lookup_price", "args": "symbol: AAPL"}` — args became a string. happens after quantized run, not FP16.
quant-bot: perf_summary: tokens/sec=54; p95=460ms; mem=24.2GB; quality_delta=-0.9% BLEU vs nova-13b (on regtest set)
kim: Priority checklist proposal: 1) Sanity perf + mem (quant vs fp16) 2) Prompt contract tests (structured json/schema) 3) Toolcall smoke 4) Eval set regressions 5) Canary rollout plan + fallback. Thoughts?
sophia: +1. Add: 2a) Test chat templates with system+assistant roles and explicit output schema blocks.
olivia: For prompt formatting, recommend a short canonical template we can reuse across SDKs:
```
System: You are an assistant that answers using JSON objects only. Do not add commentary.
User: <user prompt>
Schema: {
  \"tool\": \"string, required\",
  \"args\": \"object, required\"
}
```
olivia: Also include a validator step in the client integration that runs the received string through `json.loads` and rejects if not parseable.
raj: Re-ran the quant job with a slightly higher vocab-merge threshold, structured outputs look better but still occasional trailing commas.
sophia: Action items: @raj re-run PTQ with escape-robust tokenization settings and attach failing examples. @olivia add schema validator snippet to devdocs. @kim own canary fallback policy (auto-route to nova-13b on schema fail).
kim: will do. Canary proposal: 5% traffic -> monitor schema failure rate and semantic score; rollback at >1.5% schema failures or quality delta >1.0% over 1h.
quant-bot: new_run: https://run.redwood.ai/runs/12346 stats: tokens/sec=49 p95=520ms quality_delta=-0.3%
raj: Posting failing examples in thread in 2 mins. quick patch: escaping fix in tokenizer seems to remove trailing commas in 90% of cases.
sophia: Good. Once raj posts examples, we can add a small regression eval (10k prompts) to the intake checklist. Also need a short note for SDK teams about streaming vs buffered responses when returning structured output (buffering to validate JSON before emitting).
olivia: I'll draft a 1-pager and a sample client wrapper that buffers until valid JSON then streams. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:
sophia: Thanks — keeping this thread for the canonical intake notes. We'll convert to a checklist doc after the 10k eval. :party_parrot:
